# Roznamcha (روزنامچہ)

> Roznamcha is a modern, Urdu-first shop daily journal and accounting system for small businesses in Pakistan. It runs entirely in the browser with no backend — all data is stored locally in IndexedDB.

- Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS v3, and shadcn/ui components
- State management via Jotai; routing via React Router v7
- Right-to-left (RTL) interface in Urdu with Noto Nastaliq Urdu font
- Offline-first: works without internet after initial load
- PDF export via jsPDF and @react-pdf/renderer
- Deployed on Vercel with Vercel Analytics & Speed Insights

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/dashboard): Financial overview with summary cards and charts
- [Daily Journal (روزنامچہ)](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/roznamcha): Main transaction register — add, edit, and delete daily entries with customer names, amounts, payments, receipts, and balances
- [Invoice](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/invoice): Generate and export professional invoices as PDF
- [Expenses](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/expenses): Track and manage daily business expenses
- [Customers](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/customers): Customer directory and transaction history
- [Remaining Balances (بقایا جات)](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/remainings): Track outstanding amounts and receivables

## Source

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/RukhshanCH/Roznamcha): Full source code for the Roznamcha project

## Optional

- [Backup & Restore](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/backup): Export/import data as JSON backup files
- [Recycle Bin](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/recycle): View and restore accidentally deleted entries
- [Settings](https://roznamcha-eta.vercel.app/settings): Theme, language, and app configuration
